description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="msgPaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgPaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Shop" name="Customer and E-Shop System" processRef="Process_Ordering"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" messageRef="msgPaymentData" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPayment" targetRef="Part_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" messageRef="msgPaymentConfirmation" sourceRef="Part_Bank" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Ordering" name="Ordering in an Online Shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Ordering">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ShoppingStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterLogin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ProductMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_AllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_CustSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BillingDiffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BillMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_CustJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ShoppingStopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="E-Shop System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_LoginCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_SysSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_SysJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ShoppingStart" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterLogin" name="Enter login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginCheck" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ProductMerge" name="Products remaining to select"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_ProductsRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_SysSplit" name="Payment and shipment split"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_SysJoin" name="Payment and shipment join"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPayment" name="Send payment data" messageRef="msgPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_CustSplit" name="Payment confirmation and address split"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="msgPaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillingDiffers" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="Flow_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBilling" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillMerge" name="Billing address handled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_CustJoin" name="Payment and address join"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ShoppingStart" targetRef="Task_EnterLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterLogin" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gw_LoginCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginOk" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailed" name="Failed" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gw_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gw_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductsRemaining" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gw_SysSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gw_SysSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gw_SysSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gw_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gw_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gw_SysJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="SendTask_SendPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPayment" targetRef="Gw_CustSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gw_CustSplit" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gw_CustSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gw_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gw_BillingDiffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDiffers" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_BillingDiffers" targetRef="Task_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_BillingDiffers" targetRef="Gw_BillMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gw_BillMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Gw_BillMerge" targetRef="Gw_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Gw_CustJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
